description: Persistent Context Across Sessions for Every Agent –  Captures everything your agent does during sessions, compresses it with AI, and injects relevant context back into future sessions. Works with Claude Code, OpenClaw, Codex, Gemini, Hermes, Copilot, OpenCode + More
vibe: Ship the memory layer, skip the ceremony.
highlights: Single build command (npm run build-and-sync) bundles build, marketplace sync, and worker restart into one atomic operation.
Explicit file-location map separates source, built plugin, installed plugin, database, and Chroma paths to prevent path confusion.
Runtime dependencies (Bun, uv) are auto-installed if missing, removing setup friction for contributors.
Changelog is explicitly declared auto-generated, eliminating a common source of manual busywork and merge conflicts.
Docs are split into public MDX source and auto-deployed Mintlify site, keeping documentation and deployment in sync.
assessment: This file reflects a systems-builder's taste: it treats the repository as a pipeline with clear stages (source, build, install, runtime state) rather than a pile of files. By collapsing the build into one command and auto-installing dependencies, it removes the two most common sources of contributor drift. The explicit refusal to touch the changelog is a small but telling anti-slop rule that prevents low-value diffs.
